title: 第4章【冥婚】坟地
slug: 诡异副本勇敢者的游戏

第(1/3)页

“哥，但是现在你想怎么做？”

“第一步当然是先抢回方清的尸体。”顾原望着马家所在的方向望过去，“只有抢回了尸体才能做后续的事情。”

但是身后的几人听了脸色微微一变，似乎有些恐惧。

“哥，据我猜测马天带着方清的尸体应该是回家里了，但是想在他的家里抢到尸体，恐怕是有些困难的。”顾方的脸色也不好看，顾原并不知道发生了什么，因为剧本杀的剧本他只看了一点。

但显然，顾方是知道一些什么的。

再加上之前顾方与其他三人都没有出现介绍，所以顾原猜测，这些没有出现介绍的人，应该都是剧本杀中的人物。

“为什么？”

“跟你说不清楚，去了你就知道了。”顾方摇摇头，随后看了一眼身后的几个人，“你们三个，如果不想去，现在就回去，毕竟这件事情也很危险，一旦被发现了很有可能交代在那里了。”

身后的三个人面面相觑，露出纠结的表情，最后还是重重的点了下头，“方哥，你对哥三这么好，没理由让你们两个人涉险，我们也去。“

“就是，多个人多个照应。”

“没错。”

闻言，顾原的心中升起一股暖流，即使知道这些人并不是真人，但是他们也拥有真人的情感，并且还愿意为其赴险。

就在他们几个人准备离开的时候，身后的木门发出咯吱一声。

原本黑暗的房间灯忽的亮了起来，一个人影从门缝中探了出来。

“那个怪物走了没有？”李小饿惊恐的说着，两只眼睛不停的扫视着院子，直到确信院子中没危险才小心翼翼的走了出来。

“你还好意思出来？”顾原冷哼一声，他对这个母亲只觉得恶心。

逼迫自己女儿给将死之人冲喜，害死了女儿之后竟然连尸首都保护不住，甚至在遇到危险的时候直接逃了。

“我为什么不好意思？”李小饿冷哼一声，确信院子中没有危险之后她的胆子也大了起来，“这是我家的院子，你把我家的院子破坏成这样，你得赔偿。”

“赔偿？”顾原冷笑一声，声音逐渐狠厉，手中捡起一块板砖，一步一步的朝着李小娥走过去。

"Brother, but what do you want to do now?"

"The first step is of course to retrieve Fang Qing's body." Gu Yuan looked in the direction of Ma's house, "Only after retrieving the body can we do the follow-up."

But the faces of the people behind him changed slightly after hearing this, and they seemed to be a little scared.

"Brother, I guess Ma Tian took Fang Qing's body back home, but it might be difficult to get the body from his home." Gu Fang's face didn't look good, and Gu Yuan didn't know what happened, because he had only read a little bit of the script.

But obviously, Gu Fang knew something.

In addition, Gu Fang and the other three people did not show up for introduction before, so Gu Yuan guessed that these people who did not show up for introduction should be the characters killed in the script.

"Why?"

"I can't tell you clearly. You'll know when you get there." Gu Fang shook his head, then glanced at the people behind him, "You three, if you don't want to go, go back now. After all, this matter is also very dangerous. Once discovered, it is likely to be revealed there."

The three people behind him looked at each other with tangled expressions, and finally nodded heavily, "Brother Fang, you are so good to Brother Fang, there is no reason to put you two in danger, let's go too."

"That is, multiple people taking care of each other."

"That's right."

Hearing this, a warm current arose in Gu Yuan's heart. Even though he knew that these people were not real people, they still had the emotions of real people and were willing to take risks for them.

Just as they were about to leave, the wooden door behind them creaked.

The lights in the originally dark room suddenly turned on, and a figure poked out from the crack in the door.

"Is that monster gone?" Li Xiaoxuan said in horror, scanning the yard with his eyes until he was sure that there was no danger in the yard before he cautiously walked out.

"You still have the nerve to come out?" Gu Yuan snorted coldly. He just felt disgusted with this mother.

He forced his daughter to celebrate the death of his daughter. After killing his daughter, he was unable to even protect her body, and even ran away when in danger.

"Why am I embarrassed?" Li Xiaoxuan snorted coldly. After she was sure that there was no danger in the yard, she became bolder. "This is my yard. If you damage my yard like this, you have to compensate."

"Compensation?" Gu Yuan sneered, his voice became increasingly harsh, he picked up a brick in his hand and walked towards Li Xiao'e step by step.
